summary: CERO Therapeutics Holdings (Holdings) signed a Stock Purchase Agreement on October 6, 2026 to sell all outstanding capital stock of its wholly owned operating subsidiary, CERo Therapeutics, Inc., to SRX Global Inc. (Buyer). Consideration comprises SRX common stock valued at $1,000,000 divided by the lower of SRX's prior-day close or 20-day VWAP, forgiveness of the Consolidated Note (outstanding principal $8,249,643.77, original up to $11,666,108.77) plus accrued interest, and Buyer's assumption of approximately $1,562,000 liabilities. The Consolidated Note maturity was extended to five business days after closing or valid termination. Watch closing conditions and SRX share price volatility affecting consideration value.
